messages:
sam: Quick idea 111 rooftop hang tomorrow evening? 'Vinyl & Ice Cream'  casual, BYOC (bring your own cone). 6:00pm start?
priya: that sounds amazing. can we do a dairy-free ice cream option? i can bring a couple pints.
mike: i'll bring a little amp + records. also happy to DJ soft background vibes.
janet: Facilities check  rooftop needs a usage log and quiet curfew at 9pm. i'll block 5:457:30 for setup if you confirm headcount.
sam: thanks @janet. aiming for 6pm arrival makes sense. quick headcount please reply with :thumbsup: if in.
carmen: in! will bring snacks and labels for allergens. also small battery lanterns.
lina: i'm in but allergic to strawberries fyi.
priya: noted re: strawberry allergy. i'll label my pints. also can bring sparkling water & non-alc spritz concentrate.
mike: anyone have a folding table we can borrow? i only have records and a case.
janet: we have a couple of small folding trays in storage. i'll bring one with the cart.
sam: poll time: react with :one: for definitely, :two: maybe, :x: no.
mike: :one: definitely
carmen: :one: definitely
priya: :one: definitely
lina: :two: maybe (might be late)
janet: :one: i'll be there to set up, not to party :)
office-bot: Calendar event created: "Vinyl & Ice Cream 1 Rooftop" Tomorrow 6:00pm. Organizer: sam.
sam: awesome. mike, can you keep the volume conversational and avoid bass-heavy tracks near the east edge? neighbors are sensitive.
mike: yup will stick to mellow soul + soft indie. no metal.
carmen: ill bring a small ice bucket and spoons. anyone want cones or bowls?
priya: cones pls. more sustainable if folks bring their own spoons.
lina: heads up, public transit diversion on route 4 tomorrow night, might be a 10m delay.
sam: thanks for the heads up. i'll add transit note to the invite. also co-hosting volunteers?
carmen: happy to co-host setup.
priya: can help with clean-up at the end.
sam: perfect. i'll finalize calendar, include allergy notes and setup plan. see you tomorrow! :icecream: :notes:
